name: Family Fitness Challenge
description: Run step, distance, or activity challenges with individual or team leaderboards, in-challenge streaks, and badges. Manual entry to start.

ffc_challenges.sql: SELECT * FROM app_family_fitness_challenge__ffc_challenges ORDER BY start_date DESC

source.query: SELECT c.id AS id, c.name AS title, c.activity_label AS subtitle, p.member_id AS member_id, :today AS when_at, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS done FROM app_family_fitness_challenge__ffc_challenges c JOIN app_family_fitness_challenge__ffc_participants p ON p.challenge_id = c.id AND p.member_id = :me LEFT JOIN app_family_fitness_challenge__ffc_entries e ON e.challenge_id = c.id AND e.member_id = :me AND e.entry_date = :today WHERE c.start_date <= :today AND c.end_date >= :today ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM app_family_fitness_challenge__ffc_challenges c JOIN app_family_fitness_challenge__ffc_participants p ON p.challenge_id = c.id AND p.member_id = :me LEFT JOIN app_family_fitness_challenge__ffc_entries e ON e.challenge_id = c.id AND e.member_id = :me AND e.entry_date = :today WHERE c.start_date <= :today AND c.end_date >= :today AND e.id IS NULL LIMIT 1
